you can pull that off with script calls, but imo its seems like too a niche thing to just have in the editor seeing as how the actor images arent usually tied to any mechanics
Code:
$gameActors.actor(1).characterName() == "Actor1"
put the line in the script box for a conditional branch, change the actor ID, and use the file name without the extension of your actor's image in your img/characters folder
